_: The GRID line's choices: the input of scripts/gen-grid-calibration.ts, which writes calibration/grid-3692781.json. Policy, not measurement: every measured number (gas, legs, the prior, the buffer) is borrowed from the source chain's calibration. Owner, 2026-10-06: GRID is one more pool and job asset; a GRID job is priced, covered and made whole in GRID, on Taifoon mainnet where GRID lives.
name: Taifoon mainnet (GRID)
borrowed_why: the line's own receipts do not exist yet (it opens when GRID can be deposited into pools; GRID cannot move into the assurance contracts today): the GRID line borrows Base's calibrated gas snapshot, legs, prior, buffer and fee policy as-is until its own receipts are re-read.

asset.why: GridCredit on Taifoon mainnet: 18 decimals, PEG_USD_CENTS = 1 ($0.01, a constant). fee_decimals = 18 + log10(1 / 0.01) = 20: our gas and margin (USD) convert to GRID wei at the peg, 1 USDC unit = 1e14 GRID wei.

lp.from_source_why: the record prices a seller the same whatever token the job is paid in: the fitted prior, the risk loading, the payout share, the locked share and the max ratio are Base's
lp.lpYield_why: near zero: earned GRID has a cost basis of 0 (nothing was paid for it) and bought GRID's is the peg, with no rate to forgo on chain. 1 % rather than 0 keeps the backers' leg above zero on a line with no arbitrator (capital + ops) and gives the hook a backers' floor: setEconomyBounds(3000, 100, payee) on the GRID line
lp.opsUnits_why: the backers' own gas per job is Base's opsUnits (USDC units) converted at the peg: x 1e14 GRID wei per USDC unit (100 -> 1e16 = 0.01 GRID)

readiness: Opens when GRID can be deposited into pools.
